verdict.rationale: The Kimi help center lists 定时任务 (scheduled tasks) among its general features, alongside search, memory and skills. That is a first-party indication the assistant has a scheduled-task capability, but it is only a help-center category label with no detail on how it works. Missing for 10: documentation distinguishing recurring schedules from one-off scheduled runs, evidence that tasks run automatically unattended, how results are delivered back to the user, any limits or configuration details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule recurring or one-off tasks that run automatically and come back to me with results

citations.quote: 搜索、记忆、定时任务、技能等通用功能
